# Security Reporting

Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed vulnerability.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability-reporting facility for this repository when it is enabled. Include the affected version or revision, impact, minimal reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation. Do not submit real user data, production credentials, private keys, access tokens, or database exports.

Security response and remediation targets remain governed operational parameters. This document makes no response-time guarantee and does not identify a personal contact address.
